rationale: Plural form built on the same root as ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance' (already in glossary). Designates the assembled Light-emanations whom the First Man addresses before the cosmic battle. Preserves the active-emission verbal sense per the correspondential principle.
Abstract noun ⲙⲛⲧ- + ⲟⲩⲁϩⲓⲏⲧ 'desirous-of-heart.' Standard Coptic for ἐπιθυμία. Paired with κακία ('evil') as the moral-cosmic affect of Hyle's offspring.

Verb of motion-into, possibly Lyc. reflex of ⲡⲱⲍ/ⲡⲱϩ 'reach' or ⲡⲏϩ 'spring.' The First Man 'enters into' his god-garments — the standard armor/investiture motif. Confidence moderate; etymology unclear.

Verb of uncertain root with 3pl object suffix. In context (paired with 'wear them' and 'cast them upon each other on the members'), suggests subjection/subordination. Possibly ϩⲁⲣⲡ 'subject, snatch' or ϩⲱⲣⲡ̄. Confidence low.
Privative ⲁⲧ- + 3sg.f. suffix -ⲥ (with diaeresis marking the suffix). Standard Coptic privative formation. Tentative; could alternatively be a verbal form.
